review.instruction: Confirm route, backend application, quality verification, release, target, approval, plan digest, runner files and source head are mutually bound and the target is non-production.
Inspect the journal and plan before mutation. Classify the whole set as already applied, safely pending, invalid, partial or uncertain; only a wholly safe pending set may execute.
Confirm inspect, apply and replay use the frozen source-owned runner and configuration without editing migrations, substituting commands or exposing credential values.
Verify replay reports no pending migration, every prior journal row and checksum remains unchanged, and newly applied rows exactly match the frozen plan. Already-applied is a proved no-op.
When execution completion is uncertain, require a fresh journal observation before any action and block reapplication of any row already present or partially recorded.

failurePolicy: Identify exact plan, journal, runner or replay defects and repair only non-effect evidence. A migration effect is never retried until fresh journal observation proves it did not occur.
